alltime.source: Career lines for 1809 players from ESPN career statistics (full NBA history: 1620 career lines, 1 collected-window fallbacks) — not just the 2010-11→2025-26 box scores; as of 2026-09-25T21:21:51Z

goat.formula: GOAT score = 40% career production (PTS 40%, REB 15%, AST 15%, STL 10%, BLK 10%, 3PM 10% of the component, each career total vs the best career among qualified players) + 35% official NBA honours (points per win: MVP ×6, Finals MVP ×5, DPOY ×4.5, All-NBA 1st ×3, All-Def 1st ×2.5, All-NBA 2nd ×2, Conf MVP (W) ×2, Conf MVP (E) ×2, All-Def 2nd ×1.5, ROY ×1.5, 6MOY ×1.5, MIP ×1.5, All-Star MVP ×1.5, All-NBA 3rd ×1, Clutch POY ×1, Cup MVP ×1, Cup Tourney ×0.5, All-Rookie 1st ×0.5, All-Rookie 2nd ×0.25, Twyman-Stokes ×0.25) + 25% peak (best season's per-game impact), each component 0-100 vs the best qualified player; a component with no trusted data for a player (impossible-zero career totals, untrusted peak, no honours input) is dropped for him and the remaining weights rescaled; requires ≥82 career games.
goat.source: Production: full-career totals vs the best career among qualified players; honours: 2562 official NBA award wins across 20 award types (857 award seasons read); peak: best season impact from trusted ESPN season rows or the collected window; championship counts are display-only (57 champion seasons indexed); as of 2026-09-25T21:21:51Z

career_note: All-NBA-history careers for 1809 players (career leaders + official-award winners + 1382 collected players ≥41 GP), 2562 official honours across 20 award types; as of 2026-09-25T21:21:51Z. ESPN quirks kept as-is and captioned: ABA/NBA totals merged (Dr. J 30,026), Wilt's rebound total 0 (he's absent from ESPN's rebound leaders), the blocks leader category is mislabelled, and some pre-1977 careers have late-starting season rows (untrusted → peak/seasons blank).
